1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application has been filed with the following prayer:-
"To quash the chargesheet dated 24.09.2021 u/s 363, 366, 376 Ipc and 3/4 Pocso
Act, P.S.- Ashiyana, District- Lucknow the summoning order dated 18.01.2022
passed by Special Court, Adj, Pocso Act, Lucknow and to set aside the order dated
29.04.2022 passed by Special Court, Adj, Pocso Act, Lucknow and the entire
proceedings of S.T. No. 135/2022."

sentences.text: 3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case as the victim and the applicant were in love affairs and they had solemnized marriage on 27.04.2021, which was registered in the office of the Marriage Registrar on 18.08.2021.
Thereafter, the victim joined the company of the applicant on 13.09.2021.
However, the F.I.R. of the case in question was lodged on the basis of the concocted facts.

It is further submitted that during the course of investigation, statements of the victim were recorded u/s 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., in which, she categorically denied the prosecution story, even then, the charge-sheet was submitted by the Investigating Officer without considering the statements of the victim.

It is next submitted that the applicant and the victim are enjoying their matrimonial life and out of their wedlock, one male child was born, who is now aged about 2.5 years, hence, the impugned proceedings may be quashed.
4. The victim and the complainant of the present case are present today before this Court.

They have jointly requested that the proceedings may be quashed as due to some misunderstanding, the F.I.R.
of the case in question was lodged by the complainant.
5. The complainant has categorically stated before this Court that her daughter and the applicant are enjoying their matrimonial life and out of their wedlock, one child was born.
6. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposes the prayer of the applicant and submits that the charge-sheet has been submitted on the basis of the evidence collected by the Investigating Officer.

However, he Suyash Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt. ... on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19777664/
2 does not dispute the fact that the victim has not supported the prosecution version in her statements recorded before the Investigating Officer and the Magistrate.

sentences.text: 7. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and perusing the statements of the victim recorded u/s 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. as well as other relevant materials, it is evident that the victim has categorically stated that on 27.04.2021, she entered into marriage with the applicant and on 18.08.2021, their marriage was registered before Marriage Registrar, thereafter, she joined the company of the applicant on 13.09.2021.
It is undisputed that the victim is residing with the applicant and enjoying her matrimonial life with him and out of their wedlock, one male child was born, who is now aged about 2.5 years.
The complainant has also requested for quashing of the proceedings.
Therefore, the trial in question is futile exercise.
8. With the above observations, this application is allowed.

The charge-sheet dated 24.09.2021 u/s 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 P.O.C.S.O. Act, Police Station- Ashiyana, District- Lucknow, the summoning order dated 18.01.2022 passed by Special Court, A.D.J., P.O.C.S.O. Act, Lucknow and the order dated 29.04.2022 passed by Special Court, A.D.J., P.O.C.S.O. Act, Lucknow including the entire proceedings of S.T. No. 135/2022 are hereby quashed.
9. Office is directed to communicate this order to the trial Court, forthwith.
